gaps.explanation: Statement p6 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Fund Types - Modified Cash Basis) Total revenues: General 3,545,877.60, CDBG Loan Reuse 63.05, Debt Service 9,473.00, Economic Development LB 840 334,047.99, Other Governmental Funds 188,033.98, Total 4,077,495.62. Detail (current JSON) = General Fund statement pp16-17 3,545,877.60 + p23 special revenue combining fund columns 163,185.76 (Lafeyette Park 2,025.00, Library State Aid 7,345.33, Keno 12.07, Airport 93,166.21, Miscellaneous Funds 637.15 + 60,000.00) = 3,709,063.36. Part 1 (fixed): the CDBG Loan Reuse, Debt Service and Economic Development LB 840 columns have no schedule; their printed p6 rows are added: 63.05 + 8,936.73 + 536.27 + 333,256.25 + 791.74 = 343,584.04 -> 4,052,647.40. Part 2 (report does not add up, 24,848.22, no fix): p23 Totals column Total revenues 188,033.98 (= p6 Other Governmental Funds column) but its six printed fund columns add to 163,185.76; the whole difference is in the Other row (Totals 180,039.43 vs 2,025.00 + 93,166.21 + 60,000.00 = 155,191.21). No fund column prints the 24,848.22, so no printed line can be added (already in report_discrepancies, p23). 4,052,647.40 + 24,848.22 = 4,077,495.62.

gaps.explanation: JSON disbursements (from the p10 proprietary statement Total column) = Less: Cost purchased power 3,504,880.69 + Total operating expenses 3,510,402.30 + Interest expense 57,889.93 = 7,073,172.92. Detail holds only four one-line fund totals from the p14 all-funds Budgetary Basis schedule (detail 151 Electric 5,217,565.33, 152 Waste 626,189.06, 153 Wastewater 818,515.59, 154 Water 462,445.07 = 7,124,715.05). The p10 statement prints every expense row per fund column, and business-type revenue (above) is taken from the same p10 columns, so the p10 rows are added per column: Electric 3,504,880.69 + 1,462,661.47 (14 rows re-added: 3,433.05 + 10,407.38 + 725,968.40 + 50,288.18 + 68,988.12 + 1,547.61 + 8,340.20 + 267,464.01 + 17,968.42 + 12,035.71 + 1,185.00 + 13,330.25 + 264,306.42 + 17,398.72) + interest 27,985.73; Water 582,607.16 (13 rows re-added) + interest 11,687.00; Sewer 838,944.61 (13 rows re-added) + interest 18,217.20; Waste 626,189.06 (170.00 + 614,891.50 + 9,058.15 + 879.41 + 1,190.00). Sum 7,073,172.92. The four p14 lines are the same funds' spending counted a second time (budgetary basis) once the p10 rows are in, so they are removed: the money is held by the added p10 Electric, Waste, Sewer (p14 'Wastewater' = p10 'Sewer') and Water lines. Check: 7,124,715.05 + 7,073,172.92 - 7,124,715.05 = 7,073,172.92 = statement.
